name: Addiction To More with Gareth Gallagher

episodes.title: Coronation Street Star Emrhys Cooper EXPOSES Dark Cult Childhood, Adderall Addiction & Rock Bottom
episodes.description:
Actor, director, and storyteller Emrhys Cooper (Coronation Street, The Shuroo Process, Mamma Mia!) joins host Gareth Gallagher on Addiction to More for an unfiltered, emotional, and deeply revealing conversation. Behind the glitz of hit TV shows and red carpets, Emrhys opens up about growing up in an unconventional household with parents who joined a cult, navigating a 7-year dependency on prescription Adderall, and confronting a secret battle with alcohol.

In this episode, Emrhys shares how he was told by an industry manager at age 24 to hide his sexuality, the reality of feeling "spiritually bankrupt" while starring on national television, and how reaching rock bottom gave him a second chance at life. Now celebrating over two and a half years of sobriety, Emrhys reflects on writing his memoir, training for Ironman endurance events, and his advocacy work for cult survivors and mental health.

KEY TAKEAWAYS

The Fallacy of External Success: Hit TV roles, luxury houses, and awards cannot fix internal emptiness or spiritual bankruptcy.

Overcoming Prescription Dependency: Relying on stimulants like Adderall for creative focus masks deep-seated insecurities about intellect and self-worth.

The Heavy Price of Suppression: Hiding your identity or sexuality due to industry pressure exacts a severe toll on mental and physical health.

True Change Comes From Within: Recovery and personal growth do not require "quick-fix" weekend gurus—they start with individual accountability and wanting to change.

Transforming Pain into Advocacy: Using personal history with cults and addiction allows artists to create authentic, life-saving art and support vulnerable communities.
